2. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (Cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) - No matrix in this workflow. Not applicable.

8. P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE - No scheduled workflows.

9. P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST - Only two jobs, build then deploy. Not really applicable.

12. P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY - No queue info.

13. P-LIT-SELECT - No tests.

14. P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT - Required checks must run on each revision (deployment).
